title: Hate Speech Classification In Roman Urdu: A Comparative Study On Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning And Prompt Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2608.21408v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Due to the widespread accessibility of the internet and social media, toxic and hateful con-tent has grown exponentially, causing significant distress and negative societal impacts. Ro-man Urdu, a low-resource language used in Pakistan and among Urdu-speaking communities worldwide, presents additional challenges because of its informal grammar, inconsistent sen-tence structures, and multiple variations in word spellings. This research aims to identify the most effective techniques for hate speech classification in such low-resource settings with limited data. To address this, the study investigates and compares the latest approaches, in-cluding prompt tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using LoRA, and prompt en-gineering, under various experimental configurations. translated_title: 罗马乌尔都语中的仇恨言论分类：参数高效微调与提示工程的比较研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：由于互联网和社交媒体的广泛普及，有毒和仇恨内容呈指数级增长，造成了显著的困扰和负面社会影响。罗马乌尔都语是巴基斯坦及全球乌尔都语社区使用的一种低资源语言，因其非正式语法、不一致的句子结构以及单词拼写的多种变体，带来了额外挑战。本研究旨在识别在数据有限、资源匮乏的环境中仇恨言论分类最有效的技术。为此，研究调查并比较了最新方法，包括提示调优、使用LoRA的参数高效微调（PEFT）和提示工程，在多种实验配置下进行。为实现这一目标，设计了四个实验。第一个实验涉及无任何微调情况下直接使用大语言模型进行推理，以评估其表现。
tldr: 本研究通过对比提示调优、LoRA参数高效微调和提示工程在低资源罗马乌尔都语仇恨言论分类中的效果，确定了在有限数据下最有效的分类技术。
en_tdlr: This study compares prompt tuning, LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and prompt engineering for hate speech classification in low-resource Roman Urdu, identifying the most effective technique under limited data conditions.
